title: Agnus (Carpentras, Missa A l'ombre d'ung buissonet)
desc: Carpentras (Elzéar Genet), Missa A l'ombre d'ung buissonet, Agnus. 5 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
